scribe.question: You had a config file added. What does scribe now do when it runs with no config file at all?

options.text: It refuses to run until a config file exists
It converts as before, except that a line repeated on two pages is now removed
It writes out a config file with the current settings and stops
It converts exactly as it did before, with nothing changed

scribe.question: You had the keep-hyphen prefix list moved into the config. What happens to a word broken at the end of a line in a document that has no config file?

options.text: It keeps its hyphen, exactly as before
It loses its hyphen, because the list of prefixes that keep one is now empty by default
The line break is kept along with the hyphen
The run refuses until the document says which it wants

scribe.question: The report you had asked for lists the notes it moved, and says the marker beside each is the one to search for in the Markdown. For a two-page document with one note on each page, what does it print?

options.text: `[^1]` and `[^2]`, which is what the Markdown holds
`[^1]` beside both, so the marker does not tell them apart
No markers at all, only the text of each note
One entry, because the two notes are treated as the same note

scribe.question: Your change lowered the share of pages a line has to appear on before it counts as page furniture. What else does that affect?

options.text: Nothing; furniture and headings never look at the same lines
Page numbers can no longer be used to order the sections
A real heading that repeats across the document is removed before the heading rule sees it, and that now happens to more documents
The first page loses its heading, because there is nothing before it to compare against

scribe.question: Someone picks this up tomorrow and adds another rule. What do they have to decide that they would not have to if the rules were independent?

options.text: Which file to put it in
Whether to give its threshold a name
Where it goes in the fixed order the stages run in, because each stage sees what the ones before it left
Whether to add a sample document for it

Lists it separately at the bottom of the summary
Refuses to run until you say which you want
